# Pesher Habakkuk Column 12 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Pesher Habakkuk Column 12 where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 12:6 — "Spouter of the Lie" vs. "Spouter of Lies"
| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-Spouter-of-the-Lie" | Hebrew mattif ha-kazav — singular |
| LOGOS | "the Spouter of the Lie" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "the Spouter of Lies" | Plural for English naturalness |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "the Spouter of the Lie" (EMET/LOGOS). The Hebrew uses the singular ha-kazav (the Lie) as a sectarian title; the singular should be preserved.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 12:10 — "for the sake of his own glory" — all three agree
| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "for-the-sake-of his-own-glory" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "for the sake of his own glory" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "all for the sake of his own reputation" | "reputation" for kavod |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "for the sake of his own glory" (EMET/LOGOS). "Glory" (kavod) is the standard rendering; "reputation" diminishes the theological weight.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 12:14 — "chosen ones of God" vs. "God's chosen people"
| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-chosen-ones-of God" | Literal construct |
| LOGOS | "the chosen ones of God" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "God's chosen people" | Dynamic; "people" for bechirim |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "the chosen ones of God" (EMET/LOGOS). "Chosen ones" (bechirim) is a specific sectarian term, not synonymous with "people."

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---
*Total disagreements in Column 12: 3 | Covers Hab 2:12-14*
